title: ToolDescriptor
description: What a URTC tool head is, as a catalogue entry: its profile number, name, kind, the metric it shows, its limits, its watchdog and its features. It is static data (the profiles of the URTC tool table), not a reading of a connected head: ToolState is the reading. The Smart Rack, the Studio and the telemetry collector use it to speak about a tool in the same words. The schema is closed.

tool_id.description: The profile number a head reports as its active tool.

name.description: The stable identifier of the profile, in capitals (SOLDERING_IRON).

title.description: The name shown to a person.

kind.description: motion: the head moves or feeds something; actuator: it acts on the work; telemetry: it only measures; external: it needs an expansion board or a host.

hero_metric.description: The one number the tool is judged by (TIP TEMP, in degrees Celsius).

limits.description: The setpoint of the hero metric. A consumer checks min <= default <= max.

watchdog_ms.description: How long the head waits without a setpoint before it cuts the output.

expansion_board.description: The board the tool needs besides the head, or none.

min_firmware_version.description: The first firmware of the head that carries the tool.
